Mexican Legal Benchmarks: Interpretation, Reasoning, and Cross-Jurisdiction Evaluation
	


	
		
		Dataset Summary
	

The first specialized benchmark suite for evaluating language models on Mexican legal tasks. Three configs test distinct legal capabilities: practical interpretation of federal statutes, IRAC-structured reasoning chains with citation verification, and cross-jurisdiction comparison between Mexican states.
